seg = current_frame.segmentation

        r1, c1 = min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b)
        r2, c2 = max(p[0] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)

        child_colors = [next(cn for cn in nodes if cn['id'] == cid)['color'] for cid in n['children']]
        print(f"  ({r},{c}): children={child_colors}")

# Count small gray fragments
small_gray = sum(1 for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] < 8)
print(f"\nSmall gray fragments: {small_gray}")
</parameter>
</function>
